description: What `rv-hub verify` must report on the sample case and on each variant written by tests/samples/make_tampered.py. Every variant is verified with: --case-dir <variant>/case --evidence-dir <variant>/evidence --crosscheck off, plus `args`. `codes`: every finding code of the run with its count (findings_by_code of statistics.json), nothing else. `released_tools_disagree`: with --crosscheck auto, how many TOOL_VERIFY_DISAGREES a tool release made before verify-log re-hashed recorded outputs adds (its verify-log says intact; 0 with a current release).
